notes:
Based on the search, "underwater basket weaving" is a well-known idiom/joke phrase used to describe imaginary or absurd academic courses — it isn't a real, offered activity anywhere, and there's no actual toddler program by that name in Halton Hills or anywhere else. The Town of Halton Hills recreation site lists real toddler offerings (like tot dance/swim), but nothing matching this subject.
